messages:
maya: quick heads-up — we have a small release planned for the EU night window (02:00 CET). It’s a config toggle (kv-prefetch) + a short release blurb for the console. Need final microcopy + rollback criteria.

jon: thanks. is this going to be canaryed?

maya: yes — 5% canary at T+0, 25% at T+10, 100% at T+30 assuming no regressions. deploy-bot will run the rollout.

samir: what’s the public-facing copy? can we include the i18n bits now so L10N has time? :eyes:

maya: draft below, please review & shorten if needed. want to push both en + de + fr snippets before canary.

maya: ```
- Improved backend prefix caching (kv-prefetch) to reduce cold-start latency.
- Minor routing reliability fixes for EU regions.
```

lucy: nit: change "cold-start latency" -> "initial response latency" (less technical). Also add a note for customers on dedicated about the toggle behavior.

maya: good call. updated: ```
- Reduced initial response latency via improved prefix caching.
- Small routing reliability fixes for EU regions; no customer action required.
```

productops: can we get a one-line internal blurb for staff? we'll use it in the internal announce.

maya: internal blurb: "Deploying kv-prefetch toggle to EU tonight; will canary at 5% and scale to 100% if metrics are green. Rollback target: v2.14.2 pin. Oncall: @samir."

samir: oncall ack. what are the concrete rollback triggers?

jon: propose: error rate > 0.5% sustained for 3 mins OR 95th latency increase > 300ms vs baseline for 5 mins. also any analyst-reported quality regression from Canary prompts.

maya: agreed. I'll put that in the runbook snippet.

maya: runbook snippet to paste into ops thread: ```
Deploy plan (EU night window)
- 02:00 CET: canary 5% (deploy-bot)
- Metrics watch: error rate, 95p latency, query success rate
- Escalation: @samir -> paging policy -> rollback to v2.14.2
- Rollback criteria: error rate >0.5% for 3m OR 95p latency +300ms for 5m OR manual regression flag
```

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy to cluster: prod-eu at 2024-11-05T01:00:00Z (will trigger canary per plan) :shipit:

lucy: L10N pinged. asked for DE/FR strings by EOD.

productops: suggest we include an internal note about dedicated customers who have pinned models — they may see no change until they opt into the toggle.

maya: added to internal blurb. final internal announce copy (short): "kv-prefetch toggle rolling out to EU tonight 02:00 CET. 5% canary -> ramp to 100% if healthy. Oncall: @samir. Rollback: pin to v2.14.2 if triggers hit. See ops thread for runbook."

jon: looks good. can you add the link to the staging canary logs once available?

maya: will paste staging link after T-30 and post to this thread.

samir: standby for pages. I’ll be watching SLO dashboard and the small-signal health monitor.

lucy: L10N confirmed DE/FR copies in the thread by 20:30 CET.

productops: adding a short note to the internal release notes doc: "No behavior change expected for Dedicated customers unless they opt-in. Hosted customers will receive latency improvement."

maya: perfect. last check: are we pinning any app versions? we will pin fallback image to `redwood/inference:v2.14.2` in the rollback policy.

jon: yes, config pinned. ops playbook has the `kubectl` rollback snippet: ```
kubectl set image deploy/inference inference=redwood/inference:v2.14.2 -n prod-eu
```

maya: sweet. Ok I'll schedule the internal announce at T-15 and the public microcopy afterward if canary looks good. thanks all :thumbsup:
